question: In the review of magnetic iron oxide nanoparticles for wastewater membranes, what adsorption capacities are listed for Pb(II) and Cd(II) on the CuFe2O4/sepiolite/graphene oxide composite?
rendered: The adsorption capacities for Pb(II) and Cd(II) on the CuFe2O4/sepiolite/graphene oxide composite are 238.1 mg g−1 (for Pb(II)) and 14.97 mg g−1 (for Cd(II)).
